github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text:
Generate a commit message following this structure:
1. Start the subject line with a relevant emoji based on the change type (e.g., ✨ feat, 🐛 fix, 📝 docs, 🚀 perf, 🔧 chore, ♻️ refactor, ✅ test).
2. Write a concise subject line (under 72 chars) summarizing the core change.
3. Provide a detailed body explaining:
    - WHAT specific changes were made (mention key files/functions if applicable).
    - WHY these changes were necessary (link to issue, explain motivation).
Be thorough, clear, and informative.
